verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮਲੀ ਅਮਲੁ ਨ ਛਡਨੀ ਹੁਇ ਬਹਨਿ ਇਕਠੇ।
verses.translit_en: amalee amal na chhaddanee hui bahan ikaThe|

en.bdb: Opium-eaters eschew not opium and sit down together to eat it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜੂਏ ਜੂਆਰੀਆ ਲਗਿ ਦਾਵ ਉਪਠੇ।
verses.translit_en: jiau jooe jooaareeaa lag dhaav upaThe|

en.bdb: Gamblers indulge in play and lose their stakes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੋਰੀ ਚੋਰ ਨ ਪਲਰਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਨਿ ਗਰਠੇ।
verses.translit_en: choree chor na palareh dhukh sahan garaThe|

en.bdb: Thieves do not abandon thieving and suffer punishment when caught.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਹਨਿ ਨ ਗਣਿਕਾ ਵਾੜਿਅਹੁ ਵੇਕਰਮੀ ਲਠੇ।
verses.translit_en: rahan na ganikaa vaaRiahu vekaramee laThe|

en.bdb: The evil-doers do not remain away from the house of the ill-repute women though they sell off even their clothes to provide for them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਹੋਇ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਨਠੇ।
verses.translit_en: paapee paap kamaavadhe hoi firadhe naThe|

en.bdb: Sinners commit sin anu abscond to avoid punishment.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਸਭ ਪਾਪ ਪਣਠੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit_en: peer mureedhaa pirahaRee sabh paap panaThe ||2||

en.bdb: But, contrary to all these, the Sikhs of the Guru, (whose companionship is far from being injurious) love their Guru, and he absolves them of all their sins.
